name: Boing Testnet Passport
disclaimer: Testnet Passport records testnet participation. Activity recorded here may be considered in any future incentive or distribution program, but nothing here is a promise of tokens, an airdrop, or a mainnet claim. Rules may change; any change ships as a new rules_version.

tracks.label: Users
tracks.description: Use the testnet: wallet, faucet, transactions, Boing Finance, QA votes.

tracks.label: Builders
tracks.description: Deploy contracts that pass the QA gate, create tokens and pools, contribute code.

tracks.label: Validators
tracks.description: Run a node, join the open validator set, stay live, upgrade on time.

policy.leaderboard: public, ordered by tier, shortened addresses

quests.name: First drip
quests.description: Request testnet BOING from the faucet.
quests.howToComplete: Go to the Faucet page, paste your Boing address (or connect Boing Express), and request testnet BOING. Then submit this quest; we check the chain for a faucet transfer to your account.
quests.check: Any successful transfer to the account sent by the faucet account (boing_getAccountTransactions).

quests.name: First transaction
quests.howToComplete: Use Boing Express or the RPC to send any transaction from your account, then submit this quest.
quests.check: Any successful transaction sent by the account (boing_getAccountTransactions, direction out).

quests.name: Open Express
quests.description: Create or unlock a Boing Express wallet and copy your testnet address.
quests.howToComplete: Install or open https://boing.express, create or unlock a wallet on chain 6913, then submit your address here.
quests.check: Manual review (no on-chain marker distinguishes wallets).

quests.name: Try Finance
quests.description: Swap tokens or add liquidity on Boing Finance.
quests.howToComplete: Visit https://boing.finance, connect Boing Express, then make a small swap on Swap or add liquidity on Pools. Submit this quest; we check the chain for a call to a Boing DEX contract or pool.
quests.check: Any successful contract call (or batch step) from the account to a canonical native DEX contract or a pool from boing_listDexPools.

quests.name: Look up on Observer
quests.description: Find your account or a recent block on Boing Observer.
quests.howToComplete: Open https://boing.observer, search your address or a block height, and submit the explorer URL you used.
quests.check: Manual review of the submitted URL.

quests.name: Ship a contract
quests.description: Deploy a contract that passes the on-chain QA gate.
quests.howToComplete: Deploy any contract from your account (SDK, CLI, or a dApp). Deploys that the QA gate rejects never commit, so a committed deploy counts. Then submit this quest.
quests.check: Any successful contract_deploy transaction sent by the account.

quests.name: Join the validator set
quests.description: Run a node and register it as an open validator.
quests.howToComplete: Run boing-node with --p2p-listen and the official bootnodes (see the validator guide), fund the 100 BOING bond, and register as a validator from your account. Then submit this quest.
quests.check: Account appears in boing_getValidators (id or owner), or has sent a successful validator_register transaction.

quests.name: Share feedback
quests.description: Answer a few short questions about UX, docs, or bugs.
quests.howToComplete: Submit a link to your feedback (GitHub issue, Discord message link, or doc).

quests.name: Join community
quests.howToComplete: Join our Discord and post in #testnet-intros with your testnet account address. Submit your Discord handle.
quests.check: Manual review (verified Discord linking arrives in a later stage).
